Topology data structures and helpers for workspaces, links, tiles, and process setup.

# Purpose
This header defines the Firedancer topology data model and the helper API used to build, inspect, and run an application layout. It declares the main structures for workspaces, links, tiles, and objects in `fd_topo_t`, along with many per-tile configuration unions for network, gossip, replay, repair, and other tile types. The file also provides inline search and count helpers, plus function prototypes for joining shared memory, creating workspaces, installing XDP, starting tiles, and computing memory and page requirements. In practice, it is the central interface for topology configuration and process setup in the Firedancer runtime.
